title: RISE: Roadside Infrastructure Sequence Understanding across 3D Tracking and Structured Vision-Language Reasoning
abstract: arXiv:2608.16480v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: We present RISE (Roadside Infrastructure Sequence Understanding and Evaluation), a framework spanning metric 3D tracking and structured vision-language reasoning in roadside sequences. For metric tracking, our image-only method combines SAM3 video identities with calibration-guided mask agreement for multi-view identity association, recovering persistent 3D tracks without LiDAR or task-specific 3D training. Its calibration-conditioned geometry allows the procedure to be instantiated at different calibrated multi-camera intersections without layout-specific retraining. On 20 human-reviewed clips from six intersections, the generated tracks achieve 66.9 MOTA within the defined multi-view evaluation scope. For structured vision-language reasoning, a human-reviewed MLLM pipeline mines high-value clips and uses a constrained full-context Oracle to construct bbox-grounded predictive QA without exposing future evidence to evaluated models. translated_title: RISE：跨3D跟踪与结构化视觉-语言推理的路侧基础设施序列理解
translated_abstract: 我们提出了RISE（路侧基础设施序列理解与评估），这是一个涵盖路侧序列中度量3D跟踪和结构化视觉-语言推理的框架。对于度量跟踪，我们的纯图像方法结合SAM3视频身份与校准引导的掩码一致性，用于多视角身份关联，无需LiDAR或特定任务的3D训练即可恢复持久的3D轨迹。其校准条件几何允许该过程在不同校准的多摄像头交叉口实例化，无需针对特定布局重新训练。在来自六个交叉口的20个人工审核片段中，生成的轨迹在定义的多视角评估范围内达到66.9 MOTA。对于结构化视觉-语言推理，一个人工审核的MLLM流程挖掘高价值片段，并使用受限全上下文Oracle构建基于边界框的预测性问答，而不向评估模型暴露未来证据。
tldr: RISE通过纯图像方法实现无需LiDAR的3D跟踪，并利用受限Oracle构建防泄漏的视觉-语言推理，显著提升路侧多摄像头场景的跟踪与理解性能。
en_tdlr: RISE achieves LiDAR-free 3D tracking via image-only methods and enables leak-proof vision-language reasoning with a constrained Oracle, boosting performance in roadside multi-camera scenarios.
